context: Reproduce baselines with documented commands and checked commit before changing policy. Classify each gate as blocking or advisory and identify its actual CI wiring. Remove stale exclusions only after measuring the excluded functions. Add reason owner and review-expiry metadata or an equivalent validated sidecar. New hard gates require baseline and required-CI wiring in the same change. Avoid score-chasing refactors and do not lower thresholds merely to get green.
description: The configured Ruff contract passes, so the prior claim that develop fails lint is withdrawn. However, the custom complexity report currently has a hard ceiling above the observed non-excluded maximum, 152 function exclusions hide warning visibility, the type checker passes with warnings tolerated, and duplication uses a broad ceiling. Re-derive every baseline and make blocking versus advisory status explicit. Add ownership and expiry to retained exceptions, create strict islands for newly typed architecture, and decide _project lint coverage as policy rather than misclassifying excluded-file findings as current CI failures.

anti_patterns.dont: Delete complexity exclusions without measuring the excluded functions.
anti_patterns.instead: Measure first and classify with evidence.
anti_patterns.why: An excluded function may exceed the hard ceiling.

anti_patterns.dont: Treat explicitly excluded _project files as proof that the current Ruff contract fails.
anti_patterns.instead: Make coverage expansion a separate evidence-backed policy decision.
anti_patterns.why: That is factually incorrect under the configured scope.

anti_patterns.dont: Turn every warning into an immediate hard gate.
anti_patterns.instead: Land an honest baseline pinning and required wiring together.
anti_patterns.why: Unbaselined gates create noisy or unachievable CI.

preserves.behavior: Advisory diagnostics remain visible and explicitly labeled.
Existing production behavior is unchanged by governance-only edits.
No hard quality threshold is weakened merely to obtain a passing result.
The configured project Ruff contract remains green throughout the work.

work_units.summary: Re-derive complexity exclusion duplication type-diagnostic Ruff scope and CI-wiring baselines with reproducible commands.
Publish a gate matrix distinguishing hard fail advisory report ignored path baseline threshold and required-CI consumer.
Measure every complexity exclusion and classify retain remove or remediate with owner rationale and expiry.
Implement exclusion expiry and stale-entry validation without weakening the hard complexity ceiling.
Establish strict type-check islands around canonical run result and capability modules without expanding global ignores.
Decide whether _project remains intentionally Ruff-excluded or gains a separately baselined targeted lane.
Reassess duplication threshold policy and add a delta guard if it provides stronger signal than the absolute ceiling.
Wire approved gate changes and their pinning or drift checks atomically then document operation and rollback.
